technical_and_design_decisions: All ported modules will target Spring Cloud Stream 4.x, ensuring compatibility with Spring Framework 6.0 and Java 17+ as specified in the provided framework documentation.
The Spring Cloud Data Flow shell interface will be built using Spring Shell 3.x, following current Spring ecosystem conventions and integration patterns for REST API clients.

Module metadata will be exposed via Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties with relaxed binding, aligning with existing Spring Cloud Stream module configuration standards to ensure consistency for end users.

Ported Spring XD modules will preserve all original core functionality, with only minimal adaptations required for compatibility with the Spring Cloud Stream runtime (no new features or functionality changes beyond porting).

All implementation will adhere to the official Spring Cloud Stream module structure and contribution guidelines, reusing existing common base classes and utilities to reduce redundant development work.
assumptions: Full source code, documentation, and existing test suites for all target Spring XD modules (http, tcp, twitterstream, twittersearch, filter, transform) are available and do not require complete rewrites due to missing or obsolete legacy code.
The Spring Cloud Data Flow REST API endpoints for stream management are stable and fully documented, with no required changes to the API to support the shell interface functionality.
No new external dependencies beyond those already used in Spring Cloud Stream and Spring XD are required for the ported modules or the shell interface.
The development environment is pre-configured with all required Spring ecosystem tooling (Maven/Gradle, Spring Boot CLI, etc.), with no additional environment setup time needed.
Existing test suites for Spring XD modules can be adapted for use with the ported Spring Cloud Stream versions, reducing test development effort.
All ported modules will use the same binder implementation (e.g., Apache Kafka) for testing and deployment, eliminating the need for multi-binder compatibility work during this increment.
Documentation for the new shell interface and ported modules is out of scope for this increment, with no effort allocated for documentation development.

activities.activity_name: Design and implement Spring Shell stream command structure
activities.activity_description: Create shell command classes mapped to existing Spring Cloud Data Flow stream management REST endpoints (create, list, deploy, undeploy, destroy streams), implement input validation and error handling for all stream commands.
Add descriptive help text for all stream-related shell commands, implement tab-completion for command arguments (stream names, deployment properties, etc.) to improve user experience.

Define the standard set of module properties to expose via metadata, design configuration properties class structure aligned with Spring Cloud Stream conventions, validate relaxed binding support for all required property formats.
Create a shell command that retrieves @ConfigurationProperties-bound metadata for any available or deployed module, formats output for readability, and handles cases where metadata is unavailable.
